_what: SUPER PETREL V4.2 (from the user's V4.1, 10 Nov), fitted to the user's three LS drawings (side / top / front, scaled to the maker's 6.35 m and 8.90 m): the top wing 0.30 m forward (wgDx -0.90 -> -0.60; the engine rides it); the rod 0.15 m longer (boomLen 2.20 -> 2.40) and more inclined (rodIncl 5 -> 8); the fin with a vertical trailing edge, its corners aft (finBaseZ -0.32, finAftZ -0.40, finTipZ -0.455, finSweep 19.5 -> 7) and lower (finHeight 1.1 -> 0.95); the stabiliser rectangular (stChordTip 0.85, stSweep 0, stChord 0.75 -> 0.6) and up a tad (stY 0.70); the cabin higher (roofY 0.68 -> 0.80, aft of the bubble aftRoofY 0.12 -> 0.22, bubH 0.79 -> 0.85) and the canopy flatter-topped (bubW 1.15, topRound 0.6 -> 0.4); the spinner shorter (cw_spinLen 0.44 -> 0.24); the nose tip 3 cm up (noseDroop 0.10 -> 0.06); the nose wheel 3 cm forward (s2Z 2.88); the lower wing higher (w2Dy 0.08) with less dihedral (6 -> 4 deg); the fuel where the type has it - the leading edges of the lower wings (wing2Root 46 L + wing2Panel 45 L) and a 4 L header behind the rear bulkhead, 95 L (the 912iS POH 25 US gal; the XP maintenance manual). Empty 395 kg (maker 386), SM 12 %. Overall 6.37 x 8.87 m. Not done: the tip planform (the leading edge rounded back, the trailing edge square: no tip type draws it), the boom as the type's tapered cone (ours a rod), the cowl closing onto the spinner.
